_readme: Vital Stats, the health system games: each system's own numbers, read live on the system's own pages on the `checked` date (2026-10-01, a research pass that opened every page). `quote` keeps the phrase each number came from, so the next check is a comparison; it is not shipped. Where two of a system's own pages disagree, the question uses the one named in `src` and the `why` says so. `k` puts two questions in one family so a game deals only one of them: two facts that give each other away share a k, and a system's own hospital count shares 'count' with the federal list's. 'More than' figures are asked as 'says it has more than how many', so the stated floor is the answer. Built by scripts/build-vital-stats-systems.js.

Intermountain Health.q: How many hospitals does Intermountain Health count on its own 2025 fact sheet?
Intermountain Health.sub: Intermountain's own number, not the federal list.
Intermountain Health.why: One of them is a virtual hospital. The federal list, which runs on 2023 ownership, matches 31.

Intermountain Health.q: How many clinics does Intermountain Health count on its 2025 fact sheet?
Intermountain Health.why: Its About page rounds the number to 400.

Intermountain Health.q: How many caregivers worked for Intermountain Health in 2025?
Intermountain Health.sub: Everyone across the system: hospitals, clinics, Select Health and offices.

Intermountain Health.q: How many nurses worked for Intermountain Health in 2025, by its fact sheet?
Intermountain Health.sub: Intermountain's own count, across the whole system.

Intermountain Health.q: How many people does Select Health, Intermountain's health plan, cover, in millions?
Intermountain Health.sub: People covered by the health plan, not people treated.
Intermountain Health.why: Select Health was founded in 1983, by its own 2025 fact sheet.
Intermountain Health.quote: 1.1 M People covered by our health plan, Select Health

Intermountain Health.q: What was Intermountain Health's net operating revenue for 2025, in billions of dollars?
How many babies were born in Intermountain Health's care in 2025?
Intermountain Health.sub: Babies born in Intermountain's care, by its own count.
Intermountain Health.why: Its annual report page gives a slightly different count, 37,682.

Intermountain Health.q: How many emergency department visits did Intermountain Health count in 2025?
Intermountain Health.sub: Visits, not people: one person can visit more than once.
Intermountain Health.why: Inpatient surgeries came to 52,622 the same year.

Intermountain Health.q: How many Magnet hospitals did Intermountain Health count in 2025?
Intermountain Health.sub: Magnet is a national recognition for nursing care.
Intermountain Health.why: The same fact sheet counts 34 hospitals in all.

Kaiser Permanente.q: How many hospitals does Kaiser Permanente run, by its own count?
Kaiser Permanente.sub: Kaiser's own number, not the federal list.
Kaiser Permanente.src: Kaiser Permanente, Fast Facts (data as of June 30, 2026)
Kaiser Permanente.why: Northern California has 21, Southern California 16, the Northwest 2 and Hawaii 1.

Kaiser Permanente.q: How many medical offices does Kaiser Permanente count?
Kaiser Permanente.sub: Medical offices and other outpatient sites, by Kaiser's own count.
Kaiser Permanente.src: Kaiser Permanente, Fast Facts (data as of June 30, 2026)
Kaiser Permanente.why: Medical offices and its other outpatient facilities, counted on June 30, 2026.

Kaiser Permanente.q: How many members does Kaiser Permanente serve, in millions?
Kaiser Permanente.sub: People covered by Kaiser's health plans, counted in millions.
Kaiser Permanente.src: Kaiser Permanente, Fast Facts (data as of June 30, 2026)
Kaiser Permanente.why: Counting its Risant Health affiliates, its second quarter 2026 update puts it at nearly 13.4 million.

Kaiser Permanente.q: About how many people does Kaiser Permanente employ?
Kaiser Permanente.sub: Everyone Kaiser employs, by its own count.
Kaiser Permanente.src: Kaiser Permanente, Fast Facts (data as of June 30, 2026)
Kaiser Permanente.why: Its 2025 annual report, counted six months earlier, gives 243,795.

Kaiser Permanente.q: How many Permanente Medical Group physicians does Kaiser Permanente count?
Kaiser Permanente.sub: Doctors in Kaiser's own medical groups, not outside network doctors.
Kaiser Permanente.src: Kaiser Permanente, Fast Facts (data as of June 30, 2026)
Kaiser Permanente.why: As of December 31, 2025, not counting pool, network and referral physicians. Its annual report gives 25,505 for the same date.

Kaiser Permanente.q: How many nurses does Kaiser Permanente count?
Kaiser Permanente.src: Kaiser Permanente, Fast Facts (data as of June 30, 2026)
Kaiser Permanente.why: As of December 31, 2025. Its annual report gives 78,454 for the same date.

Kaiser Permanente.q: In how many states does Kaiser Permanente serve members?
Kaiser Permanente.sub: States where Kaiser has members, which is more than the states where it runs hospitals.
Kaiser Permanente.why: Plus the District of Columbia. Its newest region, Nevada, began in 2026.
Kaiser Permanente.quote: 12.9 million members in 9 states and the District of Columbia

Kaiser Permanente.q: What were Kaiser Permanente's combined operating revenues for 2025, in billions of dollars?
Kaiser Permanente.why: That counts Risant Health, which owns Geisinger and Cone Health. Net income was $9.3 billion.
Kaiser Permanente.quote: combined operating revenues for 2025 were $127.7 billion

Kaiser Permanente.q: How many babies were born at Kaiser Permanente in 2025?
Kaiser Permanente.why: It filled 115.3 million prescriptions the same year.

Kaiser Permanente.q: How many video visits did Kaiser Permanente hold in 2025, in millions?
Kaiser Permanente.why: Members also sent 75.9 million secure messages to their care teams.

HCA Healthcare.q: How many hospitals does HCA Healthcare run, by its own count?
HCA Healthcare.sub: HCA's own number, not the federal list.
HCA Healthcare.src: HCA Healthcare, About (data as of March 31, 2026)
HCA Healthcare.why: It was 190 at the end of 2025. The federal list, which runs on 2023 ownership, matches 157.

HCA Healthcare.q: HCA Healthcare says it has more than how many colleagues?
HCA Healthcare.sub: HCA states it as "more than" a number. Guess that number.
HCA Healthcare.src: HCA Healthcare, About (data as of March 31, 2026)
HCA Healthcare.why: More than 100,000 of them are nurses, by its nursing page.

HCA Healthcare.q: HCA Healthcare says it has more than how many nurses?
HCA Healthcare.sub: HCA states it as "more than" a number. Guess that number.
HCA Healthcare.src: HCA Healthcare, Nursing at HCA Healthcare
HCA Healthcare.why: The same page counts 25 campuses of Galen College of Nursing.

HCA Healthcare.q: How many patients did HCA Healthcare admit in 2025?
HCA Healthcare.sub: Hospital stays, not people: one person admitted twice counts twice.
HCA Healthcare.src: HCA Healthcare, fourth quarter and full year 2025 results
HCA Healthcare.why: Its emergency rooms logged 9,946,962 visits the same year.

HCA Healthcare.q: How many emergency room visits did HCA Healthcare count in 2025?
HCA Healthcare.sub: Visits, not people: one person can visit more than once.
HCA Healthcare.src: HCA Healthcare, fourth quarter and full year 2025 results

HCA Healthcare.q: How many licensed beds did HCA Healthcare count at the end of 2025?
HCA Healthcare.sub: Licensed beds: the most beds its hospitals are allowed to run.
HCA Healthcare.src: HCA Healthcare, fourth quarter and full year 2025 results
HCA Healthcare.why: Licensed beds run higher than the staffed beds its hospitals report to Medicare.

HCA Healthcare.q: What were HCA Healthcare's revenues for 2025, in billions of dollars?
HCA Healthcare.src: HCA Healthcare, fourth quarter and full year 2025 results
HCA Healthcare.why: Net income attributable to HCA was $6.784 billion.
HCA Healthcare.quote: Revenues for the year ended December 31, 2025 totaled $75.600 billion

HCA Healthcare.q: In how many U.S. states does HCA Healthcare operate, by its own count?
HCA Healthcare.sub: HCA's own count of U.S. states. It also runs hospitals in the United Kingdom.
HCA Healthcare.src: HCA Healthcare, About (data as of March 31, 2026)
HCA Healthcare.why: The federal list puts its hospitals in 19 states too.

Northwell Health.q: How many hospitals does Northwell Health run, by its own count?
Northwell Health.sub: Northwell's own number, not the federal list.
Northwell Health.why: Its count takes in Nuvance Health's hospitals. The federal list, which runs on 2023 ownership, matches 17.

Northwell Health.q: Northwell Health says it has more than how many employees?
Northwell Health.sub: Northwell states it as "more than" a number. Guess that number.
Northwell Health.why: Its fact sheet calls it the largest private employer in New York State.

Northwell Health.q: Northwell Health says it has more than how many nurses?
Northwell Health.sub: Northwell states it as "more than" a number. Guess that number.
Northwell Health.why: It also counts more than 13,500 credentialed physicians.

Northwell Health.q: How many hospital discharges did Northwell Health count in 2025, newborns and Nuvance Health left out?
Northwell Health.src: Northwell Health, 2025 annual financial information and operating data
Northwell Health.why: Ambulatory surgery visits came to 274,043 the same year.

Northwell Health.q: How many Northwell Health emergency room visits in 2025 ended with the patient treated and released?
Northwell Health.sub: Visits where the patient went home from the emergency room instead of being admitted.
Northwell Health.src: Northwell Health, 2025 annual financial information and operating data
Northwell Health.why: Nuvance Health's hospitals are not in this count.

Northwell Health.q: What was Northwell Health's total operating revenue for 2025, in billions of dollars?
Northwell Health.src: Northwell Health, 2025 annual financial information and operating data
Northwell Health.why: Nuvance Health is not in this figure. Its fact sheet puts the combined operating budget at $22.6 billion.

Northwell Health.q: How many Magnet-designated hospitals does Northwell Health count?
Northwell Health.sub: Magnet is a national recognition for nursing care.
Northwell Health.src: Northwell Health fact sheet (with Nuvance Health)
Northwell Health.why: The count is for Northwell and Nuvance Health together.

Northwell Health.q: How much did Northwell Health report in community benefit, in billions of dollars?
Northwell Health.sub: What it reports giving back to the community, such as charity care.
Northwell Health.src: Northwell Health fact sheet (with Nuvance Health)
Northwell Health.why: That is 16.4 percent of its operating expenses.
Northwell Health.quote: $2.7 billion in community benefit (16.4% of operating expenses)
